chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Jamīl ibn Darrāj, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
For the person in janabah, whatever amount of water runs over his body, little of it or much, has sufficed him.

key_terms.أَجْزَأَهُ: it has sufficed him and fulfilled the requirement
key_terms.اَلْجُنُبُ: the person in a state of janabah requiring ghusl
key_terms.جَسَدِهِ: his body over which the water must run

ai.seo_question: How much water is sufficient for ghusl of janabah in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal sufficiency of water reaching and flowing over the body in ghusl for janabah. It indicates that validity is achieved by the water’s application over the body, whether the amount is little or much.
